theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: Rank-1 eligible theme with a 0.52 durability bar and non-crowded texture (crowding_z -0.4), with weak breadth (0.353) and mixed Hurst tempering the read. The trend-gate eligibility is the only leg with validated value, and it is false here (gate did not hold), so the lean rests on continuity of thematic attention rather than any detector edge.
theses.dissent: Breadth of only 0.353 means the move is concentrated rather than confirmed; mixed Hurst suggests trend is not self-sustaining and a mean-reverting A-share tape whipsaws trend-following.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS lags CSI 300 by 5 percentage points by the 10-day check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Crowded (crowding_z 1.58, the highest in the universe) with mixed Hurst and a 0.722 breadth that suggests broad but extension-prone participation. Crowding is a size-down caution only, never a fade, so the lean is avoid rather than underweight — structural caution on a theme whose crowding flag is coincident, not directional.
evidence: eligible true but gate non-helpful on this market
theses.dissent: Banks are the classic defensive/value A-share expression with the widest breadth in the universe; crowding may simply reflect durable institutional sponsorship rather than a top.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS outperforms CSI 300 by 5 percentage points by the 10-day check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Second-highest crowding (z 1.41) with mixed Hurst and moderate breadth (0.429). Same crowding-as-caution logic as Banks; the theme is eligible but the crowding flag invites parsimony, not a directional fade.
theses.dissent: Pharma/CXO could benefit from policy tailwinds not captured in the detector and is mid-range in momentum — the crowding flag may understate a genuine structural bid.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms CSI 300 by 5 percentage points by the 10-day check-by date
